target_resolution: 1536px minimum on the shorter side; natural aspect ratio preserved
method: EDSR_x4 luminance super-resolution (90%) blended with Lanczos4 source interpolation; original source chroma; Lanczos3 final resize; no regenerated dishes
quality_limit: Source photos are approximately 100px across. Larger dimensions cannot recover absent photographic detail.

validation.crop_review: All crops visually reviewed; caption bands, borders and neighbouring tiles excluded
validation.duplicate_review: H1-079 and H1-080 have similar cup composition but different drinks/colors; retained as distinct source photos
